products.name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
products.description: A bright, floral washed coffee from smallholders around Yirgacheffe. Lovely as a filter, surprisingly sweet as espresso.

products.name: Ethiopia Guji Natural
products.description: Sun-dried on raised beds, giving a big, jammy cup that tastes like a punnet of berries.

products.name: Kenya Nyeri AA
products.description: Top-grade beans from the slopes of Mount Kenya. Juicy and bold with a sparkling acidity.

products.name: Rwanda Huye Mountain
products.description: Grown at altitude in the Southern Province and processed at a single washing station.

products.name: Burundi Kayanza
products.description: A delicate, tea-like coffee with a long, sweet finish.

products.name: Colombia Huila
products.description: An easy-going, all-rounder Colombian. Works in every brew method and with or without milk.

products.name: Colombia Nariño Pink Bourbon
products.description: A rare varietal from high in Nariño. Small lot, gone when it's gone.

products.name: Brazil Cerrado
products.description: Low acidity, heavy body and loads of nutty sweetness. A classic espresso base.

products.name: Brazil Mogiana Pulped Natural
products.description: Pulped natural processing keeps the sweetness up and the body syrupy.

products.name: Guatemala Antigua
products.description: Grown in volcanic soil between three volcanoes. Balanced, spicy and chocolatey.

products.name: Costa Rica Tarrazú Honey
products.description: Honey processed, leaving some fruit on the bean while it dries. Sweet, round and clean.

products.name: Honduras Marcala
products.description: From a producer cooperative in La Paz. A comforting everyday coffee.

products.name: Panama Boquete Geisha
products.description: The famous Geisha varietal, grown in Boquete. Our most expensive coffee, and worth it for a special occasion.

products.name: Peru Cajamarca
products.description: An organic-certified lot from northern Peru. Mellow and nutty.

products.name: Sumatra Gayo
products.description: Wet-hulled in the Indonesian style, giving an earthy, full-bodied cup that stands up to milk.

products.name: Papua New Guinea Wahgi Valley
products.description: From smallholder gardens in the Western Highlands. Tropical and lively.

products.name: India Monsooned Malabar
products.description: Exposed to monsoon winds for months, which swells the beans and mutes the acidity. Unusual and very smooth.

products.name: Australia Atherton Tablelands
products.description: Grown in Far North Queensland. A low-acid, gentle coffee from close to home.

products.name: Cumulus Espresso Blend
products.description: Our house espresso. Brazil and Colombia for body and sweetness, with a little Ethiopia for lift. Built for flat whites.

products.name: Cumulus Espresso Blend 1kg
products.description: The house espresso in a bigger bag, for home baristas who get through it fast.

products.name: Stratus Filter Blend
products.description: A lighter blend for pour-over, batch brew and plunger. Clean, sweet and fruity.

products.name: Thunderhead Dark Roast
products.description: Dark, bold and smoky. For people who like their coffee to fight back.

products.name: Cirrus Seasonal Blend
products.description: Changes with the harvest. Right now it's a bright, juicy mix of East African coffees.

products.name: Cold Brew Coarse Grind
products.description: Pre-ground coarse for cold brew. Steep overnight for a smooth, chocolatey concentrate.

products.name: Colombia Decaf (Sugarcane)
products.description: Decaffeinated using ethyl acetate from local sugarcane, which keeps a lovely sweetness.

products.name: Mexico Swiss Water Decaf
products.description: Chemical-free Swiss Water decaf from Chiapas. Nutty and mild.

products.name: Nightcloud Decaf Espresso
products.description: A decaf espresso blend that tastes like the real thing. For the after-dinner flat white.

products.name: Hand Grinder

products.name: Ceramic Pour-Over Dripper

products.name: Gooseneck Kettle

products.name: Glass Plunger (8 cup)

products.name: Stovetop Espresso Maker (6 cup)
products.description: Aluminium moka pot. Rich, strong coffee without an espresso machine.

products.name: Reusable Cup 12oz
